about: B C C Fuba India Ltd manufactures high-reliability printed circuit boards at Nalagarh, Himachal Pradesh. It supplies single-layer, double-layer, multilayer, and metal-core PCBs to OEMs in automotive, power infrastructure, telecom, defence, medical, railways, and consumer electronics [1]
